English

Generated Narrative: CodeSystem interaction-type

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/base/CodeSystem/interaction-type defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
user-to-system User to SystemA human actor initiates an exchange with a system.
system-to-user System to UserA system initiates an exchange directed at a human actor.
system-to-system System to SystemAn exchange between two systems with no human involvement.
user-to-user User to UserAn exchange between two human actors, mediated by systems.
